name: Claire Hikari no Densetsu Meisou no Hanged Man
original_name: クレール光の伝説 迷走のハングドマン
source:
In a fantasy world a beautiful princess El Claire travels together with a lewd middle-aged mercenary Bright. They hunt the monster "Ogre Hunter" in a remote countryside. A clergyman notices two suspicious travelers and comes by.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在一个奇幻世界里，美丽的公主艾尔·克莱尔和淫荡的中年雇佣兵布莱特一起旅行。他们在偏远的乡村追捕怪物“食人魔猎人”。一名牧师注意到两名可疑的旅行者并走过来。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
